purpose: Methodological references; no experimental validation claim and no new benchmark campaign yet

references.author: Wilson
references.applicability: NACA 64 A010, rectangular wing AR=6, 25%-chord plain flap. Chord Froude 1.22–4.23 and h/c 0.25–4.0. Useful for increments and depth-dependent flap effectiveness; requires a separate finite-span geometry to compare absolute coefficients.

references.author: Pernod et al.
references.applicability: NACA0012 at 5 degrees, Re=159000, Fr=0.571, URANS/VOF. Supports explicit depth sensitivity and a singlephase/VOF bridge. Its h/c observations do not establish a universal clearance limit for this foil at Re=2.142e7.

references.author: Mohammed Arab et al.
references.verified: Publisher abstract and methods excerpts; institutional manuscript search excerpt
references.applicability: NACA0012 flap experiments at Re=1e6 and 6.67 m/s. Useful pressure-based inception criterion and flap-dependent operating envelope. Not a direct absolute-coefficient benchmark for the native NACA66-012 modified. Repository metadata and manuscript excerpts differ on cavitation-bucket trend; no blanket claim that deflection increases safety.

references.author: Conolly
references.verified: Report title/year found; full-text retrieval failed
references.applicability: Potential future unsteady subcavitating benchmark. No formula or quantitative acceptance criterion adopted without reading the original assumptions.

references.author: Portal-Porras et al.
references.applicability: Rotating flap on NACA0012; CFD then ANN and RL. Methodological prior work, not hydrodynamic/cavitation validation. DRL and surrogate construction remain out of scope.
